dataList.content:
All of you. Strong.
你们。很强。

Pequod Town
裴廓德镇
dataList.content:
But no sailors.
但是，没有。水手。

Why, talk, so, slow? Irritating.
为何，说话，断断续续？恼人。

If you're not abbreviating with acronyms... then all you're doing is wasting time.
如果你不是在说缩略语，那只不过是把无聊的时间延长了而已。

Ishmael's mace nicked the harpooneer's mask. She came dangerously close to smashing their skull.
以实玛利的硬头锤有惊无险地掠过了那个人的面具。

Should've gotten out of my way when I gave you the chance... Now I'm going to have to bash your face in.
明明乖乖让开就好了……现在你的脑袋可都要被我打飞了？

dataList.title:
Pequod Town
裴廓德镇
dataList.content:
But you. You are sailor.
但……你是。水手。

... Right.
……没错。

... We both are.
我们都是水手。

Queequeg!!!
魁魁格！！！

In a sudden, explosive burst of energy, Ishmael bolted forth like a cannonball toward Queequeg before holding her in a tight embrace.
突然，以实玛利就像是炮弹发射一般飞扑了出去，紧紧抱住了那个叫魁魁格的人。

Whew... wasn't she saying something about bashing her face in just moments ago?
哇……她刚刚不是还说要打飞那个人的脑袋吗？

This embrace is what one does when meeting an old fellow.
与旧友相会，不总是如此吗。

You fear they may flutter away unless you hold them tightly so.
如果不那般紧紧相拥，就总会担忧他们飞往别处。

dataList.title:
Pequod Town
裴廓德镇
dataList.content:
Your hair color. Can't forget.
你的发色。忘不了。

dataList.title:
Pequod Town
裴廓德镇
dataList.content:
Your name. I know.
你的名字，我知道。

dataList.title:
Pequod Town
裴廓德镇
dataList.content:
But no attacking Captain.
但是，你不该，攻击，船长。

Why...? I'm just...
为什么……？我……

dataList.title:
Pequod Town
裴廓德镇
dataList.content:
You attack Captain again, I attack you.
如果再次，攻击船长。我也会，攻击你。

dataList.title:
Pequod Town
裴廓德镇
dataList.content:
Then kill or be killed. One of us.
那个时候，不是你死，就是我亡。

Well now, whatever shall you do? Starbuck here has, out of the kindness of his heart, rescued you from jaws of death. Invited you to my village!
现在，你们打算做什么？这里的斯达巴克慷慨地救了你们……甚至还邀请你们来我的镇子上做客。

Yet you've elected to attack me, as if to spit on that very kindness.
但你们还是忘恩负义，选择了攻击我。

Were we sailing the Great Lake, I would have had all of you tied and thrown overboard to be crushed underneath the keel of our ship, your lungs bloating with the Lake's waters.
这要是在一般的航行里，我早就会把你们全都用绳子捆起来，扔进大湖里拖龙骨。

There were at least 40 people living in Pequod Town. And that was a conservative estimate.
裴廓德镇的居民少说也有40人。

From their vicious glares, I could tell that every single one of them was a fiercely loyal follower of Ahab.
从他们充满敌意的眼神之中，我可以看出这里的每个居民都是亚哈的忠实船员。

Here we were in this unfamiliar environment, trapped and lost...
我们深陷在这缺少情报，也不知道该去往何方的陌生环境之中。

<Things aren't looking so good...>
<的确，情况看上去不是很好……>

A single word from Ahab, and they'll all be upon us...
只要亚哈一声令下，他们就全都会对我们刀剑相向吧。

If we were to retreat... behind us is the river of stomach acid. Ahead of us is an unknown territory.
如果我们撤退的话，身后只有会溶解身躯的胃酸河，而前方则是完全未知的领域。

Haha!! Lads, lasses! Cast fear from your hearts.
哈哈！！别老用那么害怕的表情看着我啊。

It is lucky for you, that...
你们真幸运，因为我是……

... I am nothing if not merciful. I shall forgive your transgressions thus far.
心胸宽广的船长啊！就让刚刚的无礼行为随风而去吧。

I have questions I would like to ask you, and I am certain that you have a few for me as well.
我有几个问题要问你们，你们肯定也是一样吧。

If you are willing to talk, then enter the Captain's quarters.
如果你们愿意和我聊聊的话，就来我的船长室吧。

In peace, mind.
记得要心平气和地来。

Ahab casually turned around and marched into one of the buildings. She carried herself with utmost confidence.
亚哈若无其事地转过身，大步走进了另一栋建筑。

It was almost like she knew that we would follow. That we had no choice but to follow.
她的步伐如此自信，就好像她知道我们会跟上她一样，就好像她知道我们别无选择，只能跟上她一样。

... Oi, them blokes that were glarin' at us... They're gone, like nothing happened.
……喂，后面那些家伙……刚刚还在瞪着我们……现在却若无其事地消失了？

Captain forgave. Then everyone also forgives. I forgive, too.
船长，原谅了。大家，也原谅了。我也一样。

Huh... To turn her back on someone who was charging at her with murderous intent just moments ago... It's...
哈啊……刚才还想跟我们决一死战，现在却这样背对着我们……

Yes. She is confident.
确实，她很自信。

Confident that she's got the numerical advantage, even if we were to press the offensive. Confident that we know there's more for us to lose by attacking her than by going along with her.
她明白就算发动突袭，也有会阻拦我们的船员在。攻击她将得不偿失。

With what just happened... she's made it clear as day that, at least while we're in here, she has absolute control of the situation.
仅仅通过刚才发生的情况……她就已经清晰地传达出她能掌控全局这一事实。

Talk with her? In peace...? Nonsense...
和她平和地对话……怎么可能……

<It's not like we have a way out of here...>
<就算这样，我们也没有其他出路了……>

Ishmael's gaze followed Queequeg, who walked wordlessly behind the Captain.
以实玛利的目光追随着默默跟在船长身后的魁魁格。

Haah.
哈啊。

... Let's go.
……进去吧。

Let's listen to what that bastard's got to say.
让我们听听那个混蛋要说些什么。

There's nowhere to run, after all.
毕竟这里无处可逃。

For her, or for us.
对于她，也对于我们。
